---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flexdashboard)

# Load data
nhanes <- read_csv("data/cleaned_NHANES.csv")

# Calculate avg_sbp if not already saved
if (!"avg_sbp" %in% colnames(nhanes)) {
  nhanes <- nhanes %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      avg_sbp = if (all(is.na(c_across(starts_with("systolic_bp"))))) NA_real_ else mean(c_across(starts_with("systolic_bp")), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

ggplot(nhanes, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Age", x = "Age (years)", y = "Count")

pct_adults <- round(mean(nhanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)

gauge(pct_adults, min = 0, max = 100, symbol = '%', 
      gaugeSectors(success = c(50, 100), warning = c(20, 49), danger = c(0, 19)))

pct_high_bp <- round(mean(nhanes$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)

valueBox(pct_high_bp, icon = "fa-heartbeat", color = "warning")
